fl_oz.source: TFP 2021 table footnote c (milk, juice, soft drinks: water-like density)

vegetable_oil.source: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy: vegetable oil, 1 tbsp = 13.6 g (1 tbsp = 14.787 ml) -> 0.920 g/ml -> 453.6 g = 493.2 ml = 16.68 fl oz

mayonnaise.source: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy: mayonnaise, regular, 1 tbsp = 13.8 g -> 0.933 g/ml -> 453.6 g = 486.1 ml = 16.44 fl oz

ice_cream.source: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy: ice cream, vanilla, 1 cup = 132 g (1 cup = 236.6 ml) -> 0.558 g/ml; ice cream is labeled by volume -> 453.6 g = 813 ml = 27.5 fl oz

eggs_large.source: ERS shell eggs 2021: 201.5487 eggs = 25.9737 lb retail weight per capita -> dozens per lb

lettuce.source: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy: lettuce, iceberg, 1 head medium (6 in. dia) = 539 g -> heads per lb

pinto_beans_dry.source: USDA FNS Food Buying Guide, vegetables yield table: canned pinto beans 5.51 quarter-cup heated drained servings per lb as purchased; dry pinto beans 21.00 quarter-cup cooked servings per lb. TFP beans are 99% canned, so canned lb -> dry lb = 5.51/21.00

coffee_ground.source: TFP 2021: 'a minimum of 1 cup per day of coffee or tea' for adults 20+; brewed at the Specialty Coffee Association Golden Cup ratio of 55 g per liter. 2 adults x 7 cups x 8 fl oz = 3.312 L -> 182 g = 6.42 oz ground coffee per week

rule: Each TFP Market Basket Category's weekly pounds go to the basket concepts that represent it. Within a category, pounds are split by U.S. per capita availability (USDA ERS Food Availability Data System, latest year, retail weight where published). Where no public data splits a category, the split is even and marked so. Pounds are then converted to each concept's norm unit.
